sections.title: The brain
sections.intro: Pick one of the three: the Green box, a kit, or the parts one by one. [Guide 1](docs/01-raspberry-pi-and-home-assistant.md) explains the difference.

items.name: Home Assistant Green
items.why: Plug-and-play: Home Assistant already installed. Easiest way in.

items.name: CanaKit Raspberry Pi 5 Starter Kit PRO (8 GB, 128 GB card)
items.why: Every Pi part in one box: board, case, fan, power supply, microSD.

items.name: Raspberry Pi 5, 8 GB
items.why: The board we use. 4 GB is enough for Home Assistant alone.

items.name: Raspberry Pi 27 W USB-C power supply
items.why: The Pi 5 needs 5 V at 5 A; phone chargers make it limit USB power.

items.name: Raspberry Pi Active Cooler
items.why: Stops the Pi 5 slowing itself down when it gets hot.

items.name: Official Raspberry Pi 5 case with fan
items.why: Case and cooling in one, instead of the Active Cooler.

items.name: SanDisk Extreme 128 GB microSD (A2)
items.why: Home Assistant writes to disk all day: buy a good card.

items.name: SONOFF Zigbee USB Dongle Plus (ZBDongle-E)
items.why: Zigbee radio for plugs and sensors. We use a Nortek HUSBZB-1, which is no longer sold.

items.name: ASUS ZenWiFi mesh
items.why: We use the ZenWiFi AX (XT8) 2-pack, which Amazon no longer stocks new. Any current ZenWiFi works the same with Home Assistant. Good one to buy used.

items.name: ELEGOO ESP32 dev boards, 3-pack (USB-C)
items.why: Bluetooth proxies for Home Assistant and the room tracker.

items.name: USB-A to USB-C cables, 1 ft, 5-pack
items.why: Power and flashing. They carry data, which flashing needs.

items.name: USB wall chargers, 5-pack (5 V 1 A)
items.why: One per board. An ESP32 needs very little power.

items.name: August Wi-Fi Smart Lock (4th gen)
items.why: Fits over your deadbolt; your key still works. Comes with DoorSense. We bought ours used on eBay.

sections.title: Lights
sections.intro: Hue replaced the bulb models we own (LCA005, LCA009, LTA008) in 2025. These are the current versions of the same bulbs.

items.name: Philips Hue Bridge
items.why: Links the bulbs to Home Assistant; works without the internet. Cheap used.

items.name: Hue White and Color A19, 1100 lm, 2-pack
items.why: Most of our lamps and ceiling fixtures.

items.name: Hue White and Color A21, 1600 lm, 2-pack
items.why: For tall floor lamps that need more light.

items.name: Hue White Ambiance A19, 2-pack
items.why: Warm-to-cool white only, cheaper than color.

items.name: SwitchBot Curtain 3 (rod)
items.why: Clips onto your rod; Bluetooth to Home Assistant. Also sold for U-rail and I-rail: match your track.

items.name: SwitchBot Hub 2
items.why: Optional: puts SwitchBot on Wi-Fi for the app and voice assistants; adds a temperature sensor and IR remote.

items.name: Fluval Flex 32.5 gal aquarium kit
items.why: Our tank. The integration needs a light that works with the FluvalSmart (Bluetooth) app: check the box before you buy.

items.name: SONOFF S40 Lite Zigbee smart plug
items.why: Switches the tank's UV filter (or anything else) from Home Assistant.

items.name: Roborock Qrevo Plus (Amazon Renewed)
items.why: Ours is refurbished. Vacuums, mops, empties itself, washes its pads.

items.name: Roborock Qrevo Plus (new / like new)
items.why: Same robot, main listing.

items.name: Oral-B iO Series 9
items.why: Its Bluetooth state starts the bedtime routine. The iO Series 8 works too.

sections.title: Also in our Home Assistant
sections.intro: Not needed for any guide, but they plug into Home Assistant with built-in integrations.

items.name: LG OLED evo C6, 65"
items.why: We have the older C2. LG webOS integration: on/off, volume, inputs, and the screen glows on the 3D dashboard.

items.name: Samsung HW-Q990D soundbar
items.why: Volume and sound modes from Home Assistant.
